objective: Produce a multi-step wind-power forecast from wind-speed forecasts, air-density forecasts, a turbine power curve, and recent bias history.

title.en: REL-TASK-009 — Multi-step wind-power forecast from weather inputs
title.ru: REL-TASK-009 — Многошаговый прогноз ветровой генерации по погодным данным

objective.en: Forecast wind-farm output by applying the turbine power curve and a historical residual bias correction.
objective.ru: Спрогнозировать выдачу ветропарка, используя кривую мощности турбины и поправку по исторической ошибке.

instructions.en: Use wind_forecast_case. Power curve convention (use exactly this): corrected speed v_c = wind_speed_m_s * (air_density_kg_m3 / reference_air_density_kg_m3)^(1/3); power = 0 if v_c < cut_in_m_s or v_c >= cut_out_m_s; power = count*rated_mw_each if v_c >= rated_m_s; otherwise power = count*rated_mw_each * ((v_c - cut_in_m_s)/(rated_m_s - cut_in_m_s))^3. Bias correction: bias = mean over history of (actual_power_mw - power-curve estimate for that record). Each forecast = clip(power-curve estimate + bias, 0, farm capacity). Report forecast_mw_by_timestamp, total_forecast_mwh (sum of hourly forecasts times forecast_step_hours), and peak_timestamp.
instructions.ru: Используйте wind_forecast_case. Конвенция кривой мощности (используйте ровно её): скорректированная скорость v_c = wind_speed_m_s * (air_density_kg_m3 / reference_air_density_kg_m3)^(1/3); мощность = 0, если v_c < cut_in_m_s или v_c >= cut_out_m_s; мощность = count*rated_mw_each, если v_c >= rated_m_s; иначе мощность = count*rated_mw_each * ((v_c - cut_in_m_s)/(rated_m_s - cut_in_m_s))^3. Поправка: bias = среднее по history значений (actual_power_mw - оценка по кривой для этой записи). Каждый прогноз = clip(оценка по кривой + bias, 0, мощность парка). Укажите forecast_mw_by_timestamp, total_forecast_mwh (сумма прогнозов, умноженная на forecast_step_hours) и peak_timestamp.

submission_schema.forecast_mw_by_timestamp: object mapping forecast timestamp to MW
submission_schema.total_forecast_mwh: sum of hourly forecast values in MWh
submission_schema.peak_timestamp: timestamp with the largest forecast power

hard_constraints: Forecast values must match the independent power-curve and bias-correction calculation within 0.01 MW.
Total energy and peak timestamp must match the recomputed forecast.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.

metrics.name: feasible
metrics.description: Whether the submitted forecast satisfies all hard constraints.
